name: pip
title: Pip
subject: A full-body cartoon kid in a T-shirt and shorts: arms and legs on two-bone IK, the face rig on the head, the shirt on a leaf bone for squash and stretch.
intent: A small game hero. The jump is the lesson: a crouch before it, a stretch at take-off, a hang at the top, a squash on landing with the volume kept, and a settle; the walk next to it shows how much faster and more even a cycle is.

clips.name: idle
clips.does: weight shifts from foot to foot over planted feet, a breath, a blink

clips.name: jump
clips.does: crouch, stretch at take-off, tuck and hang at the top, land squash on the contact frame (land), absorb and settle

clips.name: walk
clips.does: a march on the spot: feet lift in turn, the hips ride over the standing leg, arms swing against the legs

clips.name: cheer
clips.does: a dip, a hop with both fists thrown up, a second pump, and the arms come down
